reference.title: Cable Incline Pushdown
reference.listing: Video; the page could not be read here (blocked). The movement follows the name and a written description of the same exercise: lying back on an incline bench facing away from a high pulley, straight bar, straight arms sweeping from over the head to the thighs.

breathing.pattern: Breathe out as you sweep the bar down to the thighs; breathe in as it goes back over the head.

prescription.tempo: About 1-2 s down, short squeeze, 2 s back
prescription.load: User-chosen light-to-moderate cable weight; straight arms make it feel heavy
prescription.progression: Pause at the thighs, then more weight

cues.text: Lie back on a 45-degree bench facing away from the high pulley; hold the straight bar overhand, shoulder width, arms long over the head.
Keeping the arms straight, sweep the bar in an arc down to just above the thighs; shoulder blades set down.
Squeeze the lats with the bar just over the thighs.
Let the bar travel back over the head slowly, arms still straight, ribs down.
Brief stretch with the arms overhead.

mistakes.mistake: Bending the elbows (turning it into a triceps pushdown)
mistakes.fix: Fix the elbows softly bent; the shoulders do the work.

mistakes.mistake: Arching off the pad as the arms go overhead
mistakes.fix: Keep the ribs down and the back on the pad; shorten the range.

mistakes.mistake: Letting the cable pull the arms back fast
mistakes.fix: Control the return over about 2 s.

kinematics.norm: From arms overhead to the hands at the thighs; pullovers load the lats and pectorals through a long arc (Pezarat-Correia 2020; Teixeira 2022)
Straight arms, soft elbows, unchanged (clinical opinion)
Incline about 45 degrees; back and head on the pad (clinical opinion)
Controlled, about 1-2 s down and 2 s back (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #19230, Cable Incline Pushdown, video (movement reference)
Pezarat-Correia, Medeiros, Fernandes, Vaz, Silva and Moraes 2020, comparison of shoulder and trunk muscle activation between different pullover exercises (Rev Andal Med Deporte 13(3):127-133)

Teixeira, Gomes, da Silva, Magalhães and Marchetti 2022, differences between pullover and pulldown exercises on maximal isometric force and myoelectric activity in recreationally-trained men (Int J Exerc Sci 15(4):797-807; PMC9362894)
Campos and Silva 2014, comparison of electromyographic activity during the bench press and barbell pullover exercises (Motriz 20(2):200-205)

cautions: Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Stop if you feel sharp, radiating or nerve-type pain.
Shoulder pain or limited overhead mobility: start the arc lower (bar above the face, not over the head).
Sit down and stand up from the bench with the bar under control; ask for a hand-off if needed.
regressions: Dumbbell pullover with a light dumbbell.

muscleNotes.lats_r: Extend the shoulder through the arc from overhead to the thighs; pullover and pulldown both load the latissimus dorsi (Teixeira 2022) and it is lengthened at the overhead start.
muscleNotes.lats_l: Extend the shoulder through the arc from overhead to the thighs; pullover and pulldown both load the latissimus dorsi (Teixeira 2022) and it is lengthened at the overhead start.
muscleNotes.pec_r: The lower pectoral fibres help pull the arms down from overhead (Pezarat-Correia 2020; Campos 2014).
muscleNotes.pec_l: The lower pectoral fibres help pull the arms down from overhead (Pezarat-Correia 2020; Campos 2014).
muscleNotes.triceps_r: The long head helps extend the shoulder and keeps the elbows straight (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.triceps_l: The long head helps extend the shoulder and keeps the elbows straight (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.post_deltoid_r: Helps finish the arc toward the thighs (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.post_deltoid_l: Helps finish the arc toward the thighs (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.core: Stops the ribs flaring and the back arching (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Controls the shoulder blades overhead (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Controls the shoulder blades overhead (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_r: Set the shoulder blades as the bar comes down (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_l: Set the shoulder blades as the bar comes down (clinical opinion).
